title: truthful crew progress
acceptance: Document in design.md a mid-run reporting contract with three layers: (1) mechanical lifecycle phases emitted only from script-known nodes, (2) authored data.activity {en, zh-TW} that never invents task-specific progress from scalar titles, (3) optional bounded progress only when a true denominator exists (for example done/total). State explicitly that the 2026-09-20 captain-board prototype's random pct tick is demo-only and must not be promoted as product truth.

Remove or disable any client-side invention of percentages from coarse lifecycle state (including the working/gate/review/captain → fixed pct map). Bubbles and roster show a progress bar only when the crew payload carries explicitly bounded progress; otherwise no bar and no fake percent.

Board /api/state (or equivalent) crew payloads expose authored activity, optional bounded progress, crew_name and a truthful phase derived from event replay per T-034 rules: retain activity beyond the recent-event window, label missing activity explicitly, and never fabricate mid-run copy for visuals.

Producers: fm-worker.sh, fm-review.sh and managed herdr transport emit phase/activity (and bounded progress when applicable) through fm-emit.sh at script-known nodes such as adapter started, tests running, commit pushed, review opened, verdict signed. Cursor/Claude/Codex/Gemini share the same path; do not add vendor-only progress invention. Heartbeat-only pane text is not board state until emitted.
Throttle or coalesce high-frequency updates so the event log stays usable; a still-running heartbeat may refresh activity on an interval without claiming percent complete.

Add fail-first tests for: no bar without bounded progress, activity round-trip en/zh-TW on crew payload, phase retention across technical events, and refusal to treat missing progress as a percentage. Run repository CI and report observed results.
Implementation stays on this task's branch and PR only. Do not land this work on the T-035 / PR #51 branch. Scope remains the listed globs; widen only via captain decision.
